status: experimental CT state forecast control; not a tactical recognizer
selection: regularization penalty 0.0001 selected from seven candidates using Dust2 validation only
inputs: current 8 common state summaries plus alive CT mean normalized health/equipment; no map, IDs, time feature, or future frames
output: next snapshot common occupancy/death fractions and normalized live pair mean/max distances
constraints: nonnegative occupancy summing to one; no decreasing death fraction; 0 <= mean distance <= max distance
runtime: NumPy on CPU; PyTorch and GPU not required
known_tradeoff: better than static_snapshot_42 on current target checks, slightly worse on Dust2 published test; retrieval embeddings not provided
limitations: all target comparisons retrospective; series2396949 was observed before this model was developed
source checkpoint selection and calibration reuse the validation split
match aliases and series independence not fully audited
64 Hz and pause alignment require independent verification
no navigation geometry, tactical intent, retrieval qrels, or coaching outcome validation
integration: offline CT prediction service only; not enabled in AnalysisPipeline, Analyst, Coach, or frontend
